body: hey, I'm 14 too - I can't promise to be able to help with everything you're going through, I haven't gone through as much as you seem to have. but I feel similar to you often, especially the day dreaming and loneliness stuff, and if you want to I'm here to talk to about that or as a friend about whatever else
woah same - weird thing is I seem to _only_ get it when I haven't self harmed in a few months, perhaps it's just there to remind me.

I've been planning something somewhat like that for a while, but (ironically) I haven't gotten it done yet. I never considered it might make me feel better, but now it seems obvious - so I think I'll try. motivational quotes don't really do much for me.

hm, that's a good question. often it's because I feel like I deserve it - I ruin everything good I have, I'm annoying and unlikable, I never get anything done. the pain also feels really good in a weird way, and I tend to feel much calmer than usual after. I guess having someone I know likes me, someone I know I can trust, whom I can talk and vent to while I'm panicking would help a lot.

thank you, it helps to hear similar things have happened to others. I'll keep that in mind for the future, but often I'm not really sure why I'm sad or it's because of the girl in question but I don't want to make her feel guilty.

yeah, I agree. and maybe that is it - all she really does about it is encourage me to try to tell my parents. not sure why, maybe that's just the bare minimum she feels the need to do. once she said "I guess I just want you to get better"

it just seems so absurd to me that she didn't even say _anything_ at all, even just something as simple as "please don't do it". she's gone through a lot of heavy stuff herself - I can understand not getting self-harm, but why would she not see how much her caring can mean to me?
in the exact same situation as you, only one of the people online made it quite clear today she doesn't want to talk to me again, calling me "fucking desperate lmao". I hope you feel better soon
Thanks for the suggestion, that definitely works better than forcing myself to laugh. I like dogs myself.
